hypotheses: Rank-two firm, residually connected, flag-transitive geometries with the exact source RWPRI subgroup condition.
Both local actions are doubly transitive.
Equivalence is under automorphisms of the specified Suzuki group, as in the source; bare incidence isomorphism is a different relation.
scope.contradiction: The actual covers are the two-dimensional F8 subspaces T containing F8 inside F32768, rather than the full ambient centre. Their field-fusion action has forty-one orbits, already exceeding the printed total fourteen.
qualifications: Forty-one counts the exhibited family, not the complete corrected global classification.
The specified-group equivalence is essential to the class count.
